title: Timery Time Entry Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=timery:entry
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by tag_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Timery time entry data has stopped arriving for a given tag.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per tag and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It quietly when one part of your Timery time entry feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
